ORDINANCE III OF 2002
STAMP (BALOCHISTAN
AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE III OF 2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Stamp Act, 1899
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 4th March, 2002]
No Legis: 2-35/Law/72, dated
4-3-2002-The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Balochistan on
26th February, 2002, is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may, be called the Stamp (Balochistan
Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
